rules.preserves: Admitted Ontology and prototype-first construction invariant.
rules.rule: The seven stages select logical dependencies, not evidence that seven executions occurred. Preimplementation ontology models are non-authoritative design/navigation projections of exact authored subjects.

rules.preserves: CyberAlchemy Construction Method and its inherited source prerequisites.
rules.rule: Selecting AlchLang does not silently replace or satisfy inherited DomainSpec requirements. Before any implementation-bearing use, bind an applicable current construction route and explicit owner-selected compatibility/successor decision; absent that, refuse full construction conformance.

rules.preserves: Prototype-first construction invariant; no product or runtime approval inferred.
rules.rule: Definition semantic review/admission is distinct from Product realization approval and operational permission. Preserve prototype iteration, exact Product candidate, current Product-test evidence and Product approval requirements wherever the selected construction route requires them.

Before first generation, positive/causal-negative coverage means an exact executable check specification or fixture plan for each obligation. Results of generated behavior, output manifests and independent conformance evidence are completion requirements after generation.

rules.preserves: Contract versus observed compliance and generated evidence.
rules.rule: A handoff contract declares required future input/output bindings. An executed handoff record must bind actual selected subjects and observations; a contract file or projection intention is never evidence that a handoff ran.

A coherent authored source vector is not an Ontology Cut. A live Ontology Cut additionally requires real semantic/governance cursor and event-set bindings; no candidate file inventory fabricates those histories.

rules.preserves: Separate source standing, role assignment, native scope and exact owner decision.
rules.rule: Canonical repository standing is verified against the exact current registry and admission evidence. Native current-source views authenticate only their selected host scope; local setup and signatures cannot promote global semantics or authorize another Project.

rules.preserves: Existing scope-binding contract and actual user workspace model.
rules.rule: Product-wide inspection and candidate review may proceed without a native Project. Project-owned mutation must wait for the correct real Project/store binding. A retired migration Project, example Work statement or unresolved fixed Goal is not a substitute.

scope: Preimplementation semantic and contract review only; no operational construction or canonical admission.
